runtime.target: Mac M5 Pro, 24GB; Ollama qwen3:14b already installed; no paid API requirement
runtime.role_model: Tek yerel model, iki ayrı rol sözleşmesi, ayrılmış tool allowlist; model yanıtları yetki değildir
runtime.swiftui: Mac native GUI; Desktop yatay; iPad dikey yalnız tasarım referansı, gerçek iPad çalışma kanalı ayrı kabul gerektirir
runtime.worker: single active job, FIFO + dependencies, safe HOLD/independent proceed, 3 repair loops maximum
runtime.store: SQLite WAL single-writer, idempotent commands, append-only external evidence where required, restart reconcile unknown effects
runtime.model_endpoint: localhost Ollama; external network unavailable does not block independent local tasks
runtime.sleep: only while active job, beginActivity idleSystemSleepDisabled; release token on finish; display can sleep; Mac lid/system real sleep does not continue processing
runtime.git: authorized repo/ref/worktree + exact HEAD; human threshold for merge, publish and destructive operations
runtime.aesthetic_engine: GitHub Aesthetic engine optional / NOT_DEPENDENCY: no operational proof in this scope
runtime.old_ulak: Read-only review; never overwrite/kill/delete old Ulak, PiLive SQLite/backup and jobs until separately authorized
runtime.screen_update: trusted task projection from verified event stream; no guessed percentage; preview values visually labelled SAMPLE

finish_truth.donecheck_pass: progress + all required evidence + independent verification + required owner gates
